**Key comparison:**

- Sclerotinia: "white cotton-like mycelium" with "grayish-black sclerotia" — the white + dark combination at junction also fits

The overwhelming gray powdery/spore-like mass covering the stem surface is the hallmark of Botrytis (Gray Mold). The reference showed an earlier/drier stage without sporulation, but the symptom description aligns well with the heavy gray sporulation visible in the test image.
